name: dsh-memento
description: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness — a capability seam (ctx.memory service + local SQLite provider + memory tool + frozen snapshot injection), not another memory warehouse
readme:
# dsh-memento

**给 DeepSeek Harness 补上有界、分层、带审批门、可审计的跨会话记忆。**

> 别的记忆插件卖**仓库**，dsh-memento 卖**接缝**：类型安全的 `ctx.memory` 服务、模型绕不过去的写入审批门、能从会话日志重建的审计链。DeepSeek Harness 的原生第一方记忆——记忆协议 + 信任门
